title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels (borrowed by Peter Kafer) > Will Boswell's reel @ 7 1/2 ips; Transfer Info: Reel (Technics RS1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of an epic show featuring an acoustic first set and standout performances of “Not Fade Away” and “To Lay Me Down.”
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance, calling it one of the best shows they’ve heard. The acoustic‑driven first set is described as a treat while the second set delivers highlights like Not Fade Away, and the overall sound is praised as excellent with no reported flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews emphasize superb musical performance and crystal‑clear audio; the recording appears to be a high‑quality soundboard, leading to an overall rating near five stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as clear and crisp with no noted dropouts or muddiness; recording quality is praised throughout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic‑heavy first set is highlighted as a treat, followed by an energetic second set with several “gr8” moments and a memorable Not Fade Away.
